facts.subject: Voyager Golden Record and Azerbaijani mugham. NASA's music list (science.nasa.gov Golden Record Sounds and Music): 'Azerbaijan S.S.R., bagpipes, recorded by Radio Moscow, 2:30' — 15th of 27 music selections. Azerbaijan International (Summer 1994, azer.com): the piece is a mugham played by TWO BALABAN players (the 1978 book 'Murmurs of Earth' wrongly called it 'bagpipe'/'ugam'), 2:20, one of 27 pieces, ~90 minutes of music, greetings in 55 languages, gold-coated copper record, chosen by Carl Sagan's committee; Voyager 1 and 2 launched 20 Aug and 5 Sep 1977. Azernews 16 Sep 2013: 12-inch gold-plated disc, greetings in 55 languages, launched 1977 16 days apart. Voyager 1 reached ONE LIGHT-DAY from Earth on 17–18 Nov 2026 (NASA news release 'Voyager 1 Makes History Reaching One Light-Day From Earth', NPR 17 Nov, ABC 18 Nov, EarthSky). 1 light-day = 299 792.458 km/s × 86 400 s ≈ 25.9 billion km (our arithmetic). PERFORMER CONFLICT: Wikipedia credits Kamil Jalilov (1938–2022) with the balaban recording, but azer.com says two unnamed balaban players and a Radio Moscow recording 'probably early 1950s' (Jalilov would have been ~13) → NO performer name in text. Track length 2:30 (NASA) vs 2:20 (azer.com) → say 'təxminən 2,5 dəqiqə'? → use 'iki dəqiqədən çox' (true for both).

facts.subject: Azerbaijani alphabet changed three times in the 20th century: Arabic script → Latin (mass use from 1 Jan 1929; interpress.az 28 Jul 2022, azerbaycan-ruznamesi.org 1 Aug 2025 reposting Oxu.az, culfa-ih.gov.az) → Cyrillic (decision to switch from 1 Jan 1940; ruznamesi + Culfa) → Latin again after independence (law on restoring the Latin alphabet: 25 Dec 1991 per interpress vs 1992 per ruznamesi/Culfa → we say 'müstəqillikdən sonra', no year). Full switch of print: decree 18 Jun 2001 required Latin print by 1 Aug 2001 (interpress); 'keçid 2001-ci ildə başa çatdırılıb' (ruznamesi) vs '2004 sərəncamı ilə tam' (Culfa) → we say '2001-ci il avqustun 1-dən qəzetlər latınla çıxmalı oldu' (decree wording). 1 August = Azərbaycan Əlifbası və Azərbaycan Dili Günü, decree 9 Aug 2001 (all 3 agree). Current alphabet: 32 letters (interpress only → 15:23/20:45 confirm with a 2nd source or drop the number). 1922 committee / 1923 parallel use (interpress + ruznamesi) — not in voice.

FACT: Azıx mağarası discovered 1960 by the ANAS expedition of Məmmədəli Hüseynov (en.wikipedia Azykh Cave + Mammadali Huseynov). June 1968: a lower-jaw fragment found in the 5th layer (science.gov.az 'June 1968', '4th horizon of the 5th layer'; Wikipedia Huseynov '1968 … 5th stratum'; Azykhantrop page '1968'). It belonged to a young woman — 18–22 (Wikipedia Huseynov; science.gov.az D. Hajiyev study) / 18–20 (science.gov.az 1st paragraph) → we say 'təxminən 20 yaşlı'. Age 350–400 000 years (Wikipedia Huseynov + science.gov.az) BUT Wikipedia Azykhantrop infobox says 250 000 and text 'estimates 450 000–50 000' → always 'alimlərin hesablamasına görə'. Species: Heidelberg-type / close to Neanderthal (sources differ) → say 'qədim insan', name 'Azıxantrop'.
